title: streptanthus glandulosus subsp. albidus
intro: Streptanthus glandulosus subsp. albidus, commonly known as White-leaved Larkspur, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness due to its sedative and anti-anxiety effects. The health benefits of White-leaved Larkspur include its ability to act as an anxiolytic, antispasmodic, and sedative, which can help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
